canonical_project: Interchange Port Vila Cable Station Data Centre (ICX)
notes: Archived official Interchange project page (2013) lists new data centre facilities with 22 racks incorporated within the Port Vila cable station of the ICX submarine cable system (Port Vila-Suva, linking to Southern Cross), including co-location facilities for customers; cable ready for service Jan 2014. Still referenced as the Vanuatu landing station/colo point. No public MW capacity.
